rule: A new row needs a page dated 2025–2026 that names it and carries a copied sentence (scripts/library-check.cjs), then a Baidu Maps check: ok only when the map shows the place at the page's address, not closed, with a review from the last six months. Prices marked 'Baidu Maps' are the map's spend per person; where the page and the map disagree, 'Check the price'.
agents: four Haiku agents, five web searches each; 43 rows offered, 16 passed library-check.cjs, 10 went in
